question: Does the latest original same-vintage US semiconductor/electronic-component industrial-production month-over-month change add five-session future SOXX return information beyond the original Stage1 39 inputs, source-release age and index-base regime? Positive output-growth coefficient is preregistered from a demand-recovery interpretation; this source is broader than chip-only production.
novelty_boundary: Different physical-output mechanism from closed Fed capacity utilization, semiconductor PPI, issuer-share creation, VIX term structure, duration/tech-breadth and daily-volume screens. Do not reopen those by sign, lag or window changes.

parent.baseline_features: exact 39 base_features order from frozen Stage1 seed71 model

candidate_source.source_caveat: 192 original versions, 2011-2022 complete; next-real-session conservative publication lag, 2025 maximum age78 days; within-vintage MoM only, no absolute level splice or current FRED revised history.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum_j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j))
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval; train strictly before 2023-01-01 America/New_York, held by 2026-10-10 America/New_York
label.role: information-only, no fee-net account or SOXX promotion claim

model.baseline: Original 39 Stage1 features plus fixed release_age_days and two index-base dummies (2007, 2012; 2017 reference); SimpleImputer(median), StandardScaler, Ridge(alpha=1.0)
model.candidate: Same rows and pipeline plus exactly ip_mom_pct_same_vintage

gate.paired_metric: baseline squared error minus candidate squared error on identical held signal dates

stops: Stop before fits if source hashes, exact train/held rows, label maturity or full feature calendar differ
After source and cohort checks fit only the fixed baseline and candidate; seal both model bytes before held scoring
A failed gate closes this exact source/receiver/label version: no sign, lag, age cutoff, rebasing, release-window, Ridge or regime rescue
A pass is development feedback only: historical first receipt and definition continuity, full Stage1 account, 0/2/5bp and independent forward remain separate gates
